audit_answers.1_minimum_legal_concrete_adapter: One explicitly injected, non-default local exact-blob filesystem adapter implementing only DurableAuthorityReader and DurableAuthorityWriter. It stores one canonical envelope byte sequence at one deterministic family+exact-ref address, performs exact read-back, delegates all authority validation to N4E-A, and is not mounted by startup or selected as product backend policy.
audit_answers.2_does_implementation_require_Owner_back: NO for the bounded candidate adapter. The local filesystem mechanism can remain an implementation detail because it is explicitly named, injectable, non-default, has no startup binding, and does not prevent another adapter from being added. A future production mount/deployment still requires its own Owner gate.
audit_answers.3_can_existing_low_level_filesystem_stor: YES. Python/POSIX primitives already available to the repository can be composed: os.open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, exact writes, file fsync, atomic no-overwrite hard-link publication, directory fsync, regular-file no-symlink reads, and SHA-256 path derivation. No repository-owned generic durable helper is ready for direct reuse.
audit_answers.4_exact_durability_integrity_guarantees: Write only a complete pre-validated canonical envelope byte sequence; fsync the temporary file before publication; publish with no-overwrite hard link; fsync the family directory; read exact bytes without semantic transformation; reject all missing/malformed/corrupt/nonregular/symlink/path-collision states; reject every corrupt record during reconstruction enumeration; preserve identical bytes and reject conflicting duplicates.
audit_answers.5_is_one_bounded_adapter_node_READY_now: YES, subject to the exact allowed paths, inputs, failure behavior, and test surface in this artifact.

minimum_concrete_adapter.name: Exact Local Filesystem Durable Authority Adapter
minimum_concrete_adapter.addressing_model: root / AuthorityFamily.value / SHA-256(UTF-8 exact authority_object_ref URI) hex + fixed envelope suffix
minimum_concrete_adapter.physical_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON of envelope.to_dict() followed by exactly one LF byte
minimum_concrete_adapter.validation_ownership: All envelope and governed-object validation remains in julia_core.durable_authority accepted N4E-A functions; adapter adds only physical/path/encoding validation.

steps: derive final exact-ref path without interpreting payload
reject missing root/family directory rather than creating state
create a unique temporary regular file in the same family directory with O_CREAT|O_EXCL
write the complete canonical envelope bytes and exactly one LF
flush and fsync the temporary file
atomically publish using hard-link creation, which fails if final path already exists
fsync the family directory
remove the temporary file and fsync the directory again if cleanup succeeds
on existing final path, read and compare exact bytes
exact_write_model.idempotent_duplicate_policy: Exact byte-for-byte duplicate may return success only after full validation and byte equality.
exact_write_model.conflict_policy: Any different byte sequence, digest, family, ref, or filename collision fails closed and leaves no authority substitution.
exact_write_model.partial_success_policy: A call that cannot prove durability returns failure. A crash-published final object must still be exact or all later reads fail closed; identical-byte retry is the only permitted success path.

exact_read_model.input: exact AuthorityFamily + exact typed ref supplied by caller
steps: derive the deterministic final path
reject missing root/family/path
open with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW and require a regular file
read all bytes exactly
require exactly one terminal LF and no extra terminal blank data
strict UTF-8 decode and strict JSON object decode
construct through envelope_from_dict
run accepted validate_envelope_semantics
require family, exact ref URI, and path digest to agree
exact_read_model.success: Return the already-valid exact envelope object while tests separately verify raw stored-byte preservation.

corruption_model.policy: Every case fails closed. read_exact and list_exact_refs must not skip an corrupt record, continue past it, select another record, repair it, or return partial success.
corruption_model.temporary_file_policy: A failed or crashed temporary file must never be treated as an authority object. Unexpected temp files must make reconstruction enumeration fail until explicitly handled by a separately authorized non-semantic recovery procedure; no such recovery is authorized in the next node.

reconstruction_enumeration_model.purpose: list_exact_refs(family) for N4E restoration mechanics only
steps: enumerate only the exact expected envelope filename pattern in the one requested family directory
reject unexpected entries
read and fully validate every object using exact-read rules
verify each object's family and authority_object_ref and deterministic filename digest
return sorted exact ref URIs solely for deterministic repository reconstruction
reconstruction_enumeration_model.ordering_semantics: Sorting is mechanical determinism only. Governance order remains inside each validated envelope; predecessor closure remains owned by N4E reconstruction.

physical_backend_policy.reason: An explicitly injected local filesystem adapter does not establish PostgreSQL/SQLite/JSONL/filesystem/object-store product architecture, cannot be discovered by runtime, and does not preclude additional adapters. Promoting or mounting any adapter as production storage remains an Owner gate.

REQUIRED_INPUTS: explicit pre-existing temporary root created by test/setup
already-governed exact DurableAuthorityEnvelope objects from N4E-A tests
FORBIDDEN_PATHS: julia_core/runtime_canonical_binding/** except read-only imports if strictly needed
EXPECTED_TEST_SURFACE: all three authority families round-trip exact envelope objects
raw physical bytes hash identically before and after read
read_exact uses deterministic exact address without repository selection
identical duplicate is byte-verified and non-mutating
missing root/family/object fails closed and creates nothing
list_exact_refs is deterministic and validates every record
unexpected/corrupt enumeration entry fails entire list
concurrent same-object writers produce one exact object and reject conflict
restore_* repository reconstruction composes with adapter
no latest/current/default/active/best/first selection strings or behavior
no fixture promotion, startup wiring, production writes, or semantic interpretation
